newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin says he will return to Kremlin on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin says he will return to Kremlin on Monday.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, saying Russia needs "an active" leader, told the nation on Friday he would return to his Kremlin desk on Monday morning.
"The country needs an active and energetic president, especially now," Yeltsin said in a televised interview, the first since his multiple heart bypass operation on November 5.
